proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Read the dimension statement off the relative dimension lemma for supports of flat modules, then compare coefficients at the generic point of any r-dimensional integral closed subscheme of the closed fibre by unwinding the cycle class of a coherent sheaf as a sum of lengths at the minimal primes of the local module, apply the additivity lemma for divisors restricted to a principal vanishing order to factor the length of the reduction modulo a uniformizer through the lengths at those primes, observe that flatness makes the uniformizer a nonzerodivisor so the minimal primes correspond exactly to the generic points of the generic-fibre support specializing to the chosen point, and identify both sides coefficient by coefficient (source lines 427-456)
